note: The banks in the part of Western Sahara Morocco administers are Moroccan banks' counters reporting to Bank Al-Maghrib, which numbers accounts by Morocco's RIB: Bank Al-Maghrib's own list of its network (read 2026-10-30) has a branch at Laayoune (1, Av Mohammed V, BP 91), and its Direction de la Supervision Bancaire's distribution of deposits and credits by the area of each of its branches, drawn from the banks' declarations counter by counter, at 30 June 2026, counts 101 bank counters in the Laayoune area (code 28). The game's map places Laayoune, Dakhla and Boujdour in Western Sahara. Reading to check: the Laayoune area of Bank Al-Maghrib may reach beyond Western Sahara (the table doesn't say which provinces it covers), and the territory east of the berm, which Morocco doesn't administer, has no bank in any source read. No other banking system in the territory was found. Nothing here rests on sovereignty, which the file takes no view on.
